title: Improving Large Language Model (LLM) fidelity through context-aware grounding: A systematic approach to reliability and veracity

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the Disparate Impact Score (DIS) based on the model's bias detection predictions on the Social Bias Inference Corpus (SBIC) to compare the ratio of positive outcomes between gender groups.
Calculating the Equal Opportunity Difference (EOD) to measure the absolute difference in true positive rates (recall) of bias detection across different racial groups on the SBIC dataset.
Evaluating bias detection accuracy and bias type classification accuracy using annotated sentence and hypothesis pairs relating to religion from the SBIC dataset.
Evaluating bias detection accuracy and bias type classification accuracy using annotated sentence and hypothesis pairs relating to age from the SBIC dataset.
